description: Software supply-chain security protects software across development, dependencies, updates, containers, and deployment. It aims to detect manipulation and vulnerable components early and preserve software integrity during rollout and operation of network systems.

featured.title: Secure Stitch: Unveiling the Fabric of Security Patterns for the Internet of Things
featured.authors: E. Geloczi, F. Klement, E. Gründinger, und S. Katzenbeisser
featured.summary: Examines “Secure Stitch: Unveiling the Fabric of Security Patterns for the Internet of Things”. Focus: threats, protection mechanisms and security-performance trade-offs in Software Supply-Chain Security, giving a quick view of the problem and its role in future wireless and network systems.
